summary: Round 2 only. Jan English is a project machine translation, not an edition translation; all semantic decisions rest on the Turoyo. Round-1 proposals are inherited in the reading layout and are not repeated in this JSON.
mawdeno in coordination with mhaymanno directly confirms inherited bekennen/glauben. moḏe in a coerced content clause is kept as the source’s contracted/ḏ spelling, not silently normalized.
Mawdele supplies the previously empty Preterit box with thanking in response to divine assistance; l Aloho is shared by the coordinated verbs. No unattested paradigm is added.
Confirm the phonological relation and stem allocation of moḏe (Jan 2.18/3719) beside mawde; its content and syntax support acknowledgment.
Can danken be used with human l-recipients as well as God? Sense 2 has one attestation.
Compelled acknowledgment of a political identity extends the content beyond profession of Christian faith without a new sense.
